notes.text: Rasmus Dahlin is out (upper body injury) and has missed the last 2 games. He is one of their most valuable skaters. Olen Zellweger has taken his spot beside Mattias Samuelsson.
Jason Zucker is on injured reserve (abdomen surgery) and has not played this season.
Dennis Gilbert was added to the roster on Oct 14.
Zach Metsa has started killing penalties: on the ice for 48% of the team’s shorthanded time in 8 games, up from 7% last season.
Josh Norris has started killing penalties: on the ice for 27% of the team’s shorthanded time in 8 games, up from 1% last season.
Ivan Demidov is on injured reserve (lower-body injury) and has missed the last 5 games. He is one of their most valuable skaters.
Mike Matheson is out (lower-body injury) and has missed the last 2 games. He is a top-pair defenseman. Lane Hutson has taken his spot beside Noah Dobson.
Oliver Kapanen has not played this season.
Owen Beck was added to the roster on Oct 14 and has played beside Jake Evans and Kirby Dach.
Arber Xhekaj has started killing penalties: on the ice for 30% of the team’s shorthanded time in 7 games, up from 6% last season.

MTL.head: Anybody’s game
MTL.body: Montréal has home-ice advantage, while Buffalo will be without Dahlin. Then again, Buffalo has been out-chancing opponents lately, and Montréal will be without Demidov. For the Canadiens, the difference could be keeping shots to a minimum.

BUF.head: A genuine toss-up
BUF.body: Montréal has home-ice advantage, while Buffalo will be without Dahlin. Then again, Buffalo has been out-chancing opponents lately, and Montréal will be without Demidov. For the Sabres, the difference could be getting good looks.

story.head: Suzuki’s favorite opponent
paras: The Canadiens won the first meeting this season, 4-3 in a shootout in Montréal. The Sabres come in at 4-3-1, the Habs at 3-3-1.
At home, Martin St. Louis likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Sabres’ first line. The Sabres have the edge over the Canadiens on preventing dangerous shots.

items.text: Nick Suzuki has a point in nine straight games against Buffalo, and 21 points in his last 13 against them.
The Sabres are newly without Rasmus Dahlin, and have had to make do without Alex Lyon and Jason Zucker all season. Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen is expected to start.

The Canadiens are newly without Mike Matheson, have been without Ivan Demidov and Samuel Montembeault for several games, and have had to make do without Oliver Kapanen all season. Jacob Fowler is expected to start.
Tage Thompson is one goal from passing Jason Pominville for tenth on the Sabres’ all-time goals list.
